# Konrad Kopczynski

> Fractional head of AI operations for multi-location home services and service businesses, based in Kingston, NY. I pick the one number that matters most across your locations, build the AI system that moves it, run it for 90 days and leave it running.

I built Titan, an AI operating system for home services companies, and rolled it out to 120+ locations in two franchise systems. In our own locations it took field labor from 50% to 30% of revenue, cut cost per hire from about $1,000 to $100-150 with a text screener, and collected close to 100% of invoices. Before that I was VP Data & Intelligence at Croud, running a 43-person team and a $9M analytics P&L.

Engagements start with a two-week fixed-price audit, then about 4 days a month at $10,000 a month, month to month after 90 days. At most four companies at a time.

Contact: konrad@kopczynski.us · Book 30 minutes: https://cal.com/kopczynski/30min · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/kkopczyn
